What if every human had a clone that hated them?
You walk past a mirror.
Your reflection doesn't move.
It's you.
But it's staring at you with pure hate.
Then.
That's over eight billion clones.
In 1996, Dolly the sheep became the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.
It took two hundred seventy-seven tries.
Your clone would share your DNA… but not a single one of your memories.
It would start life as a baby.
Even identical twins, nature's own clones, have different fingerprints.
Eight billion people.
Each hunted by their own face.
But here's the twist.
Your clone could never truly be you.
It doesn't know your fears or your secrets.
Only one person does… you.
So remember.
Your worst enemy was never a copy.
Would you want to meet your clone?
